opportunities.name: Book a Resy special event in a city
opportunities.description: On Resy, switch to a given city, open its Special Events & Experiences list, pick an event, choose the number of tickets (and a time slot if offered), and go to the Complete Your Reservation step.
steps: Open resy.com and click the city selector
Open the Special Events & Experiences list (city restaurant list / 'See More')
Open the tickets dropdown and choose {ticket_count}
Check the order details in the 'Complete Your Reservation' dialog and click Reserve / Complete

instances.values: city=Miami; event=American Express Presents CARBONE BEACH 2023 (Thu May 4); tickets=3; Centurion Member Access, Book Now
city=Atlanta; event=Aria HAPPY HOUR BURGER (Apr 13); tickets=1; time=5:00 PM

opportunities.name: Track a Megabus by service number
opportunities.description: On megabus.com, open 'Check my bus', switch to the Service Number tab, type a service/route number, pick the matching route, and click Find my bus.
steps: Open megabus.com and click 'Check my bus' in the header
Choose the bus tracker option in the dropdown
Type {service_number} into the 'Search by Service Number' field
Pick the matching route from the suggestions

instances.values: Service number search started (no number visible); the account was logged out, with a Houston→Dallas search in the form

opportunities.name: Find national parks by state on NPS.gov
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use the Find a Park 'By State' dropdown to pick a state, then open a park's information link (Basic Information, Current Conditions, Heritage Areas) on the state page.
steps: Click the 'By State...' dropdown under Find a Park
On the state parks page, find {park}
Click the {info_link} for that park (e.g. Basic Information, Current Conditions, National Heritage Areas)

instances.values: state=Alaska (and Florida); opened Dry Tortugas Current Conditions and Alaska National Heritage Areas → Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm
